description: Typical asking rent in a city or area on Roomly, from live listings: the median and the usual range for a room, a whole apartment and a sublet, with how many listings it is based on. Use it when someone asks what rent costs or whether a price is fair. Returns monthly median, typical low and high, in the local currency.
